source_facts.quantization: RedHatAI FP8-Dynamic checkpoint quantized with llm-compressor (FP8_Dynamic + iMatrix); vision/audio embedding layers excluded from quantization per the RedHatAI card
source_facts.vllm_min_version: no pinned stable release published as of 2026-07-28; RedHatAI's card states the checkpoint is validated against vLLM nightly builds only, not a specific release (unlike gemma4-26b-a4b-fp8's 0.19.0)
source_facts.transformers_min_version: not pinned by the RedHatAI card as of 2026-07-28
source_facts.release_status: preliminary upstream checkpoint; subject to change
source_facts.cuda_runtime_note: RedHatAI card states nightly-vLLM validation only; RTX 6000 Ada requires local boot, tokenizer canary, and runtime validation before production claims -- see configs/main_model_profiles.yaml gemma4-12b-unified-fp8.compatibility for the actual host validation history

upstream_example.note: RedHatAI's own eval command uses a $MAX_MODEL_LEN placeholder (no concrete suggested value), unlike gemma4-26b-a4b-fp8's card which gives 96000 explicitly
upstream_example.quantization: model_config compressed-tensors; do not pass --quantization fp8

source_facts.modality_architecture_note: Encoder-free unified multimodal architecture -- image/audio/video project directly into the LLM embedding space with no separate vision/audio towers (unlike gemma4-26b-a4b-fp8, which supports only text+image). Source -- ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/core/model_card_4.

upstream_context_length_tokens.official_spec_source: ai.google.dev Gemma 4 model card, "12B Unified" row (256K)
upstream_context_length_tokens.vllm_recipe_note: docs.vllm.ai/projects/recipes/.../Gemma4.html lists E2B/E4B/26B-A4B/31B but has no 12B entry as of 2026-07-28, so there is no vLLM-recipe reference number the way gemma4-26b-a4b-fp8 has 131072

parameter_summary.architecture: dense -- no MoE, unlike gemma4-26b-a4b-fp8's 26B-total/4B-active split; all parameters are active during inference

project_runtime_policy.policy_reason: RTX 6000 Ada에서 RedHatAI preliminary FP8 checkpoint에 대한 50K context, seq=3, optimization level 3 런타임 target이다(2026-07-28 default profile; 실측 boot/KV-cache 검증 이력은 configs/main_model_profiles.yaml의 gemma4-12b-unified-fp8.compatibility 참고). 공식 스펙은 256K context이므로, 이 플랫폼은 production을 주장하기 전에 로컬 tokenizer, boot, 품질, 지연시간, soak 검증이 필요하다
project_runtime_policy.chat_content_contract: OpenAI chat content string or content parts with text, image_url, input_audio, and video_url
project_runtime_policy.image_url_policy_reason: 기본값으로 임의 server-side URL fetch를 피한다; MIME, 디코드된 image bytes, image dimensions를 검증한다; 외부 HTTPS image fetch는 egress 정책 뒤에서만 활성화해야 한다
project_runtime_policy.request_parameter_policy: bounded allowlist in configs/model_serving.yaml; unknown chat fields rejected at Gateway
